prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyperrealistic black-and-white extreme close-up portrait of an adult man's face, tightly framing one eye, cheekbone, nose bridge, and lips. Bright sunlight breaks into soft wavy luminous lines that ripple diagonally across his skin like underwater reflections. Render visible pores, faint freckles, subtle stubble, and natural imperfections in lifelike detail. Let the eye reflect fragments of the luminous waves without an artificial glow. Use razor-thin macro depth of field: one illuminated ridge of skin is perfectly sharp while the rest melts into velvety blur. The background disappears into soft gray gradients. Add fine cinematic grain and keep the mood intimate, surreal, fluid, and emotionally evocative.
